feed.title: AI Science Tracker: additions and source checks

entry.title: Machine learning predicts early diabetic kidney disease in a retrospective hospital cohort
entry.summary: Researchers evaluated six survival models in 1,006 patients with type 2 diabetes from one hospital. XGBoost using nine predictors, including the atherogenic index of plasma, achieved one-, three- and five-year AUCs of 0.784, 0.761 and 0.752 in 302 randomly held-out patients. This was internal… (Discovery - Lanzhou University Second Hospital; Lanzhou University; announced 2026-06-30)

entry.title: Beyond Correlation: A Causality-Driven Machine Learning Framework to Climate-Crop Yield Data Using Transfer Entropy and Lag Optimization Approaches
entry.summary: Transfer entropy screened climate variables and lags, and regressors predicted maize and soybean yields from 40 years of USDA-NASS data for 88 Ohio counties. The held-out results describe observational climate-yield associations; a random split does not establish causality or broad geographic… (Discovery - Not stated in the abstract reviewed; announced 2026-11-20)

entry.title: Generative discovery of chemical reaction networks
entry.summary: Version 2 reports NMR characterization of four isolated products, including three predicted diarylation structures; v1 contains earlier family-level MS evidence. The isolated products are supported by 1H/13C NMR; this validates structures, not every proposed reaction path, rate or barrier. The… (Discovery - Affiliation not stated in the reviewed material; announced 2026-11-18)

entry.title: Construction and Validation of a Machine Learning-Based Risk Prediction Model for Recurrent Upper Gastrointestinal Bleeding in Patients with Liver Cirrhosis: A Prospective Study
entry.summary: A machine-learning risk model for recurrent upper-GI bleeding in cirrhosis was assessed in a prospective development cohort and an independent external cohort. The selected logistic model achieved external AUC 0.827 (95% CI 0.747–0.907). This supports prediction in the studied cohorts; it does not… (Discovery - Affiliation not stated in the reviewed material; announced 2026-11-18)

entry.title: Geodesic-informed neural networks for testing spacetimes with S2
entry.summary: Across five tested alternatives, the fit improvement over Schwarzschild did not offset the evidence penalty. The reported log Bayes factors span approximately -3.4 to -0.8 for the stated priors and dataset. Verified against an exact numerical solver and checked posterior approximation in… (Discovery - Department of Physics, University of Waterloo, Waterloo, Ontario, Canada; announced 2026-11-18)

entry.title: MISP Galaxy Cluster import authorization weakness
entry.summary: CIRCL disclosed a Galaxy Cluster import authorization weakness affecting organization boundaries in MISP. The CVE record documents a corrective change. (Vulnerability - CIRCL; ENISA; CERT.pl; announced 2026-11-18)

entry.title: Measured beam-loss reduction from shaped proton distributions at CERN accelerators
entry.summary: At CERN’s Super Proton Synchrotron, resonant excitation reshaped the vertical proton-beam distribution before extraction; the paper reports measured loss reductions up to 23.5%. Surrogate models based on generative deep learning supported rapid validation and Bayesian system identification, with… (Discovery - CERN; announced 2026-11-17)

entry.title: How far can routine process records predict final turbidity in industrial beer crossflow filtration? A capability-boundary study on 5000 production batches
entry.summary: Across 5,000 brewery batches, models using routine process records explained at most about 8% of held-out turbidity variance; no nonlinear model beat linear baselines and a learning curve plateaued near R²=.10. This is a specific industrial observability/capability result, bounded to the recorded… (Discovery - Affiliation not stated in the reviewed material; announced 2026-11-17)

entry.title: Comparative Supervised Machine Learning for Predicting Cardiovascular Disease among Indian Adults 45 Years or Older: Evidence from the LASI Wave 1
entry.summary: In LASI Wave 1, a held-out sample of 19,335 adults supported retrospective discrimination of current, survey-defined CVD status (Random Forest AUC 0.728, Brier 0.177). This is a cohort-specific retrospective clinical classification result; it does not establish incident-risk prediction, causation… (Discovery - Affiliation not stated in the reviewed material; announced 2026-11-17)

entry.title: Machine learning identifies candidate sepsis molecular subtypes and associated markers
entry.summary: Transcriptomic clustering and machine-learning feature selection identified three candidate sepsis groups with differing observed 28-day outcomes and a four-gene classifier. A separate dataset and cell experiments provide exploratory checks. The authors caution that these groups are not… (Discovery - Chengdu University of Traditional Chinese Medicine; Hospital of Chengdu University of Traditional Chinese Medicine, Chengdu, China; announced 2026-11-17)

entry.title: Breaking the Fixed-Substrate Limitation of Deep Learning Ellipsometry with Pseudo-Substrate Spectra
entry.summary: FiLM-DLE takes both a thin-film spectrum and a pre-deposition pseudo-substrate spectrum as inputs. On 47 measured films across diverse substrates, its optical-constant and thickness estimates had mean absolute errors of 0.047, 0.030 and 1.52 nm, respectively, against manual analysis; each analysis… (Discovery - National Institute of Advanced Industrial Science and Technology; Nagaoka University of Technology; announced 2026-11-16)

entry.title: Decoding Complications: Large Language Model-Based Classification of Free-Text Entries in Clinical Stroke Registries
entry.summary: The primary source Methods/Results confirm the represented result: An LLM-guided taxonomy classifies 9,146 free-text stroke-registry adverse-event entries, with frozen GPT-5.4 labels matching clinician consensus on 300 held-out entries (weighted F1 96.5%) and recovering 19.6% more adverse-event… (Discovery - Affiliation not stated in the reviewed material; announced 2026-11-16)

entry.title: Deep learning predicts mortality in a multicenter severe COVID-19 ICU cohort
entry.summary: A deep learning model was assessed in registry data for 900 patients treated in intensive care at 22 Korean centers during 2020–2021. A reduced seven-variable model had an AUC of 0.8247, compared with 0.8500 for the 66-variable model. This is a retrospective prediction result; the study does not… (Discovery - Chonnam National University Hospital, Gwangju, Korea; announced 2026-11-16)

entry.title: Reasoning in the loop: antibody lead optimization by probing mechanism and measurement
entry.summary: In two controlled antibody lead-optimization campaigns, Claude and researchers identified misleading thermal assay proxies, revised measurements and experimentally improved anti-albumin VHH and anti-mesothelin scFv leads. Small final-lead replicate counts; no mammalian expression, stress testing… (Discovery - Anthropic; BigHat Biosciences; announced 2026-11-15)

entry.title: Machine-learning-assisted prediction and optimization of tensile strength in particulate-filled polymer composites
entry.summary: LASSO, K-nearest neighbors, support-vector regression and genetic-algorithm-optimized SVR were compared for tensile-strength prediction in metal-powder/resin composites. Evaluation used nested five-fold cross-validation on 45 experimental conditions, so performance is bounded to this dataset. (Discovery - Not stated in the abstract reviewed; announced 2026-11-15)

entry.title: FADS1 serves as a candidate shared biomarker for metabolic dysfunction-associated steatohepatitis related early-onset colorectal cancer identified via machine learning and in vitro validation
entry.summary: ML nominates FADS1 as a candidate shared biomarker in MASH-associated early-onset colorectal cancer, with public-cohort analyses and limited laboratory assays. Authors describe associations and acknowledge no direct genetic perturbation; the result is exploratory. (Discovery - Affiliation not stated in the reviewed material; announced 2026-11-15)

entry.title: Unsupervised machine learning identifies early stage breast cancer subclasses from aberrant glycogene expression and informs personalised drug treatment.
entry.summary: GHSORM clustering of glycogene expression in 785 early-stage breast-cancer samples identified seven expression subclasses, and RFES selected 60 genes that classified the clusters with 90.48% accuracy on a held-out set. I-SPY2 pCR patterns are retrospective and exploratory; the study does not… (Discovery - University of KwaZulu-Natal; announced 2026-11-14)

entry.title: Do student perceptions mirror reality? A mixed-methods study to evaluate the accuracy, utility and efficiency of AI-assisted feedback in introductory mathematics courses
entry.summary: Two introductory mathematics courses were studied using Gemini 2.5 Pro to draft scores/feedback from submissions and course references. Study One compared human-only (159 students) with human-curated AI (89); Study Two compared AI, peer and professor feedback. entry.title: Scaling laws in machine learning on non-ideal experimental data enable inverse design of radiative-cooling coatings
entry.summary: Machine learning on 11,520 experimentally fabricated radiative-cooling coatings showed power-law decreases in prediction error as training data increased. Experimentally tested inverse designs matched a broadband-emitter target more closely with larger datasets, but did not outperform the best… (Discovery - Affiliation not stated in the reviewed material; announced 2026-11-14)

entry.summary: The primary publisher Methods/Results support the AI-enabled result: CRISPR-Cas13a assay with ML-designed guide sets discriminating SARS-CoV-2 from twelve sarbecoviruses, validated with in vitro data; distinct assay result with an identified ML design role. entry.title: Deep-learning models show limited external performance for preterm-birth prediction from cervical ultrasound
entry.summary: The study reports internal evaluation and external evaluation on a separate ultrasound machine; the external AUC was 0.52. External discrimination was modest; clinical usefulness and improved pregnancy outcomes are not established. Prospective sample collection does not establish prospective… (Discovery - Translational Health Science and Technology Institute; announced 2026-11-14)

entry.title: X-Strata separates aneurysm sacs and overlapping vessels in two-view angiography
entry.summary: X-Strata uses learned decomposition of cine angiography and parallax between two views to infer aneurysm-sac and vessel layers and reconstruct a 3D sac surface. On 220 held-out patients from three centers, including 122 external cases, the method ranked first among 14 baselines for sac recovery in… (Discovery - Tsinghua University; Hunan University; Chinese PLA General Hospital; Air Force Medical Center of the Chinese PLA; announced 2026-11-13)

entry.summary: In simulated Home Assistant outage runs, LLM agents showed model- and warning-time-dependent recovery; qwen3.8-27b fixed 94% of faulted devices in the reported test setting, and trace analysis identified recurring failure modes. This is a bounded smart-home resilience result, not evidence of… (Discovery - School of Electrical Engineering and Computer Science, Oregon State University; announced 2026-11-13)

entry.title: Mapping the Phase Space of Cubic Chiral Semiconductors: High-Throughput Search,Stability, and Prototype Families
entry.summary: A high-throughput computational search of 24,227 cubic chiral structures identified 368 candidates on the computed convex hull and 3,048 within 50 meV/atom. Selected candidates were refined with density-functional theory, and several prototype families showed computed intermediate-band features.… (Discovery - University of Liverpool; University of Cambridge; announced 2026-11-13)

entry.title: Machine Learning-Based Prediction of Disease-Free Survival in Breast Cancer Incorporating Clinical and Treatment Information: Retrospective Cohort Study With External Validation.
entry.summary: An XGBoost accelerated-failure-time model combined clinical, pathological and treatment information to predict postoperative disease-free survival. It was developed on 861 patients, internally validated on 370 patients and externally evaluated on 304 TCGA patients; this retrospective validation… (Discovery - The Affiliated People’s Hospital of Jiangsu University; Shantou University Medical College; announced 2026-11-13)

entry.title: FFNN-GA-Assisted Process Modeling and Optimization of Banana Fiber Pretreatment for Retrieval of Cellulose fiber and Other Value-Added Byproducts
entry.summary: The AI-guided search identified a candidate pretreatment condition that balanced lignin recovery, sugar loss, and cellulose preservation. The paper reports a confirmatory experiment at the predicted condition as well as train/validation/test model checks. This is a small study with data available… (Discovery - Not stated in the reviewed material; announced 2026-11-13)

entry.title: Deep learning identifies an antimicrobial peptide from mealworm
entry.summary: Selected candidate peptides were tested against Gram-positive and Gram-negative bacteria; the reported activity is in vitro. The study does not establish safety or effectiveness in animals or people. (Discovery - Hangzhou Normal University; Chinese Academy of Agricultural Sciences; announced 2026-11-13)

entry.title: Certified Improvements to Best-Known Thomson-Problem Configurations with a Search Pipeline Built with Large Language Model Agents
entry.summary: The agent-built search found lower-energy strict local minima for Thomson configurations at N=912, 1382 and 2502; exact-integer certificates and a separate verification implementation checked local minima. (Discovery - Zhejiang University; Independent Researcher; Georgia Institute of Technology; Nanjing University; announced 2026-11-13)

entry.title: AI-Assisted Failure Prediction on Postoperative X-Rays: A Head-to-Head Comparison with Consultant Trauma Surgeons
entry.summary: A prospectively assembled 466-patient application cohort (104 fixation failures) was classified from postoperative radiographs by a ResNet-50 trained on a disjoint 200-patient cohort. entry.title: Agentic AI discovers verifier-checked fault-tolerant quantum circuits
entry.summary: An LLM-guided evolutionary search produced circuits for encoded-state preparation, logical gates and code switching across quantum error-correction codes. An exhaustive verifier checked the stated circuit operations and fault-tolerance criteria. entry.title: Unsupervised Machine Learning Classification of FRB 20121102A across Distinct Active Episodes: Implications for FRB Emission Physics and Source Environments
entry.summary: Four clusters were identified. Cluster 1 contains nearly all high-energy bursts and has mean energy about an order of magnitude above the other clusters; it has bimodal-like central-frequency/bandwidth distributions and occupies a distinct width–fluence region. entry.title: A neural quantum state variational Monte Carlo study of Aharonov-Casher bands
entry.summary: Neural variational Monte Carlo wave functions, benchmarked against multiband exact diagonalization on small systems, were used to map phases in the Aharonov–Casher continuum model up to 36 electrons. At filling 2/3 the calculations identified an incommensurate electron Wigner crystal and a… (Discovery - University of California, Berkeley; University of Cambridge; announced 2026-11-12)

entry.title: Identification and characterization of ion channel-related signatures in ulcerative colitis: an integrated multi-omics and machine learning analysis
entry.summary: multi-dataset transcriptomics, WGCNA and ML; four HICGs TRPM6/FXYD3/CNGA1/KCNJ15; training AUC .979 and independent cohort AUCs .864–.981; scRNA/spatial profiles plus DSS-colitis RT-qPCR/IHC. (Discovery - Affiliation not stated in the reviewed material; announced 2026-11-11)

entry.title: Sparse constrained model discovery identifies isotropic material limit surfaces
entry.summary: The study compares sparse invariant libraries and physically gated mixtures of experts for fitting physically admissible yield and failure surfaces. Across five experimental datasets, richer invariant terms substantially improved the concrete fit (fourfold lower cross-validated error) and a… (Discovery - Technical University of Darmstadt; announced 2026-11-11)

entry.summary: Perioperative-data models predicted chronic postsurgical pain after anal fistula surgery, using a held-out test set with 19 outcome cases; performance is therefore preliminary. entry.title: Evaluation of machine learning-based prediction of pregnancy complications and adverse birth outcomes using routine data.
entry.summary: Using 442,760 Kaiser Permanente Northern California pregnancies, separate XGBoost models predicted gestational hypertension, gestational diabetes and pre-eclampsia at 12 weeks; prediction of four adverse birth outcomes was weaker. Transfer to a 6,105-pregnancy cohort required local tuning, and… (Discovery - Kaiser Permanente Northern California; announced 2026-11-11)

entry.title: Construction of a machine learning-based risk prediction model for acute stroke in maintenance hemodialysis patients
entry.summary: A model developed from 1,100 maintenance-hemodialysis patients predicted acute stroke in a held-out 330-patient test set. XGBoost achieved AUC 0.847 (95% CI 0.791–0.902), sensitivity 0.73 and specificity 0.83. The study is single-center and retrospective; external validation and clinical benefit… (Discovery - Department of Nursing; Kidney Disease Center, The First Affiliated Hospital, Zhejiang University School of Medicine; announced 2026-11-11)

entry.summary: On 6,048 balanced ChestX-ray14 cases, HuatuoGPT-Vision and Qwen2.5-VL detected none of 432 pneumothorax-positive cases; comparison models detected 38% and 67%. entry.title: An internally validated model predicts intervention-free survival after adenomyosis surgery
entry.summary: A 541-patient cohort was used for model development and internal performance assessment. External validation and evidence that model use changes treatment or patient outcomes are not established. (Discovery - Huazhong University of Science and Technology; announced 2026-11-11)
